correctness.rationale: For U complement of super dominating set D in K_m square K_n, a selected cell privately witnesses omitted (i,j) exactly when the omitted row/column endpoint has degree1 and opposite bipartite part has an isolate. Therefore the incidence graph B(U) is (i) a star forest with isolated row and column, or (ii)/(iii) a nonsurjective row->column or column->row function. Exponential labeled-star specification counts (i) with disjoint center convention; two Stirling corrections count (ii)/(iii). For m,n>=5 edge max m+n-4 forces exactly one long row-star and one long column-star, with m(m-1)n(n-1) ordered labels. Independent direct bitmask enumeration matched the polynomial for 3x3 {0:1,1:9,2:36,3:42} and 4x4 {0:1,1:16,2:120,3:416,4:608}; original checker inspected for 5x5 optimum enumeration. Infinite m,n statement follows combinatorially, not from finite board checks.
